items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We did a lot of traveling over in Europe and the United States, but a lot of traveling especially in Spain... Tete – we had this tour set up. So I fly over to – I fly to Spain.

ctx.x: Tete Montoliu, Tete, Tete Montoliu. Tete was blind. He had to have someone take him around. We did a lot of traveling over in Europe and the United States, but a lot of traveling especially in Spain.
